mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counseling_records ( student_id, -- 상담 대상 학생 ID parent_id, -- 학부모 상담 시 학부모 ID teacher_id, -- 상담 담당 강사 ID counseling_date, -- 상담일 counseling_type, -- 상담 유형 content, -- 상담 내용 visibility_code, -- 공개 범위 created_by -- 등록자 ID ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{parentId}, #{teacherId}, #{counselingDate}, #{counselingType}, #{content}, #{visibilityCode}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, -- 학생 ID u.name AS student_name, -- 학생 이름 s.student_no, -- 학생 관리번호 s.school_name, -- 학교명 s.grade_level -- 학년 FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN enrollments en ON en.student_id = s.student_id WHERE en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name, s.student_id

SELECT p.parent_id, -- 학부모 ID u.name AS parent_name, -- 학부모 이름 sp.relation_code, -- 관계 sp.primary_yn -- 대표 보호자 여부 FROM student_parents sp JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = sp.parent_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE sp.student_id = #{studentId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sp.primary_yn DESC, u.name

SELECT p.parent_id, -- 학부모 ID u.name AS parent_name, -- 학부모 이름 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT su.name, ', ') AS student_names FROM student_parents sp JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = sp.parent_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = sp.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id JOIN enrollments en ON en.student_id = s.student_id WHERE u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND su.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY p.parent_id, u.name ORDER BY u.name, p.parent_id
SELECT t.teacher_id, -- 강사 ID u.name AS teacher_name, -- 강사 이름 t.subject -- 담당 과목 FROM teachers t JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name, t.teacher_id
SELECT t.teacher_id, u.user_id, u.name AS teacher_name, t.subject FROM teachers t JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT cr.counseling_id, -- 상담 ID cr.student_id, -- 학생 ID su.name AS student_name, -- 학생 이름 s.student_no, -- 학생 관리번호 cr.parent_id, -- 학부모 ID pu.name AS parent_name, -- 학부모 이름 cr.teacher_id, -- 강사 ID tu.name AS teacher_name, -- 강사 이름 cr.counseling_date, -- 상담일 cr.counseling_type, -- 상담 유형 cr.content, -- 상담 내용 cr.visibility_code, -- 공개 범위 cr.created_by, -- 등록자 ID cu.name AS created_by_name, -- 등록자 이름 cr.created_at -- 등록일시 FROM counseling_records cr JOIN students s ON s.student_id = cr.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = cr.parent_id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = cr.created_by WHERE cr.counseling_id = #{counselingId}
AND ( cr.visibility_code = 'SHARED' OR cr.created_by = #{viewerUserId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teachers viewer_teacher WHERE viewer_teacher.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id AND viewer_teacher.user_id = #{viewerUserId} ) )

AND created_by = #{viewerUserId}
